title: Production of recombinant interferon inhibitor B18R
author: Alexandr V. Shustov
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kp8cvrw

steps.title: Prepare Night Culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 5 ml of Luria-Bertani (LB) medium containing kanamycin (50 ug/ml) with 5 ul of a cryo-culture of expression strain BL21(DE3) transformed with plasmid pET28/B18R(HisTag).

substeps.instruction: Incubate overnight at 37°C on a shaker at 150 rpm.

steps.title: Scale-up and Protein Induction
steps.instruction: Transfer the night culture into 1L of LB medium with kanamycin (50 ug/ml).

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 37°C on a shaker (150 rpm) until the optical density at 600 nm (OD600) reaches 0.8.
Add isopropyl β-D-thiogalactoside (IPTG) to a final concentration of 1 mM.
Grow the induced culture for 6 hours at 37°C (150 rpm).

steps.title: Harvest and Wash Bacterial Cells
steps.instruction: Collect the bacterial cells via centrifugation and wash the biomass.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge cells at 8000 rpm for 10 min.
Resuspend the pellet in 50 ml of water.
Centrifuge again at 8000 rpm for 10 min to pellet the cells.

steps.title: Lysis and Enzymatic Treatment
steps.instruction: Resuspend the bacterial biomass to a 10% suspension in lysis buffer (20% sucrose, 20 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 5 mM MgCl2, 0.1% Triton-X100).

substeps.instruction: Add 1/100 volume of lysozyme stock, 1/100 volume of DNAse I stock, 1/100 volume of RNase stock, and 1/1000 volume of PMSF stock.
Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 1 hour.

steps.title: Chemical Lysis and Sonication
steps.instruction: Add sodium deoxycholate (SDC) dry powder to the mixture to a final concentration of 0.5% (w/v) and dissolve.

substeps.instruction: Treat the mixture with an ultrasonic disruptor on an ice bath using a sonotrode matching the mixture volume.
Apply 20 pulses at 50% amplitude, each pulse lasting 30 seconds with 3-minute pauses, until the mixture is no longer viscous.

steps.title: Isolate Inclusion Bodies
steps.instruction: Separate the insoluble fraction containing inclusion bodies by centrifuging the mixture at 12000 rpm for 30 min at 4°C.

steps.title: Wash Inclusion Bodies
steps.instruction: Remove bacterial lipids and impurities from the pellet through sequential washes.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend inclusion bodies to a 10% suspension in wash buffer with SDC (100 mM Tris pH 8.0, 2 mM EDTA, 0.5% SDC).
Sonicate briefly to disintegrate pellet chunks and centrifuge to pellet the inclusion bodies.
Resuspend inclusion bodies (to 10%) in buffer TE (100 mM Tris pH 8.0, 2 mM EDTA) without SDC, sonicate briefly, and re-pellet.
Repeat the TE wash one more time.

steps.title: Store Inclusion Bodies
steps.instruction: Weigh the washed inclusion body pellet and divide into 70 mg portions.

substeps.instruction: Store portions at -80°C.

steps.title: Solubilize Protein
steps.instruction: Dissolve a 70 mg portion of inclusion bodies in 100 ml of solubilization buffer (50 mM Tris pH 10, 2% sodium lauroyl sarcosinate (SLS)).

substeps.instruction: Stir the suspension at room temperature for 2 hours.

steps.title: Oxidative Folding
steps.instruction: Add CuSO4 to the protein solution to a final concentration of 50 µM.

substeps.instruction: Stir the solution in an open flask on a magnetic stirrer for 20 hours at room temperature.

steps.title: Precipitate Protein
steps.instruction: Add 25 g of ammonium sulfate ((NH4)2SO4) to 100 ml of the protein solution (final concentration 40% w/v).

substeps.instruction: Incubate the solution for 2 hours in an ice bath.
Centrifuge at 10000 rpm for 20 min to precipitate the protein.

steps.title: Prepare for Chromatography
steps.instruction: Dissolve the precipitate in 20 ml of IMAC buffer A containing 6M urea (20 mM Na2HPO4 pH 7.4, 500 mM NaCl, 20 mM imidazole, 6M urea).

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge to remove any undissolved material.

steps.title: Metal-Affinity Chromatography (IMAC)
steps.instruction: Perform IMAC using a His GraviTrap column (GE Healthcare) prepared per manufacturer's instructions.

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate the column with 10 ml of buffer A + 6M urea.
Load the protein solution onto the column.
Wash the column with 20 ml of buffer A + 6M urea.
Elute the protein with 10 ml of IMAC buffer B + 6M urea (20 mM Na2HPO4 pH 7.4, 500 mM NaCl, 500 mM imidazole, 6M urea) and collect the eluate.

steps.title: Dialysis and Purification
steps.instruction: Subject the collected eluate to dialysis against 2 L of PBS.

substeps.instruction: Perform dialysis for two days at +8°C, including three buffer changes.

steps.title: Final Processing and Storage
steps.instruction: Filter-sterilize the clear B18R solution through a 0.22-um filter.

substeps.instruction: Measure protein concentration using the Bradford method.
Store the solution at -80°C.
